subject: Vendr evidence ingest checkpoint + manifest handoff
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@greenfield-fin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: portal-vendr@greenfield-fin.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile - bulk evidence ingest + manifest spec

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Greenfield is ramping to finish our Vendr profile this month. Security asked me to confirm two things so you can start the automated ingest:

1) Manifest format: do you accept a CSV manifest with columns: object_key, evidence_type, control_mapping, md5, timestamp_utc, provenance_id? If not, what's the preferred header set?
2) Delivery: we can either upload artifacts to an S3 bucket you provide (preferred) or post them through the Vendr UI. Which do you prefer for an initial bulk load?

We also have a partially-completed CAIQ set (attached) — will anything be rejected by your ingest if several items are already answered in the portal?

Goal: get the first 200 docs ingested this week so security can move to the attestation step.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Principal Security Engineer
Greenfield Financial

Attachments: greenfield-caiq-partial-20270514.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@greenfield-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile - bulk evidence ingest + manifest spec

Hi Alex — great to hear. Short answers up front:

- Manifest: yes, we prefer CSV with the headers you listed, plus an optional "retention_policy" column if Greenfield has specific retention tags. The provenance_id field is important for idempotency; we'll dedupe on that.
- Delivery: S3 upload is preferred for bulk loads. We'll provide a pre-signed upload prefix and a short-lived role to write objects.
- CAIQ: Vendr will accept partial CAIQ answers; the ingest will create or update fragments. We won't reject partial sets, but question-level conflicts will surface in the portal for manual review.

I'm looping in Marissa (Trust Ops) and Ben (Security Engineering) to coordinate the manifest template and the S3 path. Proposed schedule: you upload by EOD Monday 5/17; we'll ingest a dry-run Tuesday morning, and provide a QC report by EOD Tuesday. Does that work?

Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Vendr manifest template + retention tags (draft)

Karthik / Ben —

Dropping the draft manifest and a short ingest checklist (see attached). Key implementation notes for the dry-run:

- We will dedupe on provenance_id; if the incoming object_key already exists and provenance_id differs, we'll mark as a potential duplicate and include it in the QC report.
- retention_policy values accepted: "standard", "sensitive", "ephemeral" — these map to S3 lifecycle rules.
- MD5 is required for every object. If MD5 fails on upload, the manifest line is marked failed.
- For CAIQ fragments we map question IDs to portal controls; mismatches will create a reconciliation task in Vendr.

Attachments included: evidence-manifest-20270518.csv (CSV, sample 200 rows), ingest-checklist-20270518.md (markdown).

Please confirm the S3 prefix below is OK for the Greenfield upload; once confirmed I'll generate pre-signed PutObject links and an STS role.

S3 prefix: s3://redwood-evidence/greenfield/ingest-20270518/

Marissa Cole
Trust Operations Lead
